prompt:
You are an expert digital ASIC and FPGA Verilog design engineer.
Implement the module 'TopModule' satisfying the exact specification below.

SPECIFICATION:

I would like you to implement a module named TopModule with the following
interface. All input and output ports are one bit unless otherwise
specified.

 - input  clk
 - input  load
 - input  ena  (  2 bits)
 - input  data (100 bits)
 - output q    (100 bits)

The module should implement a 100-bit left/right rotator, with
synchronous load and left/right enable. A rotator shifts-in the
shifted-out bit from the other end of the register, unlike a shifter that
discards the shifted-out bit and shifts in a zero. If enabled, a rotator
rotates the bits around and does not modify/discard them.

  (1) load: Loads shift register with data[99:0] instead of rotating.
      Synchronous active high.

  (2) ena[1:0]: Synchronous. Chooses whether and which direction to
      rotate:
      (a) 2'b01 rotates right by one bit,
      (b) 2'b10 rotates left by one bit,
      (c) 2'b00 and 2'b11 do not rotate.

  (3) q: The contents of the rotator.



RULES:
1. Write clean, synthesizable, standard Verilog (IEEE 1364-2001/2005 or SystemVerilog 2012).
2. The module name MUST be 'TopModule'.
3. Output ONLY the module code enclosed in a ```verilog ... ``` code block.
4. Ensure all port names and bit-widths match the specification exactly.
raw_response:
```verilog
module TopModule (
    input  wire        clk,
    input  wire        load,
    input  wire [ 1:0] ena,
    input  wire [99:0] data,
    output reg  [99:0] q
);

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (load) begin
            q <= data;
        end else begin
            case (ena)
                2'b01:   // Rotate right by one bit
                    q <= {q[0], q[99:1]};
                2'b10:   // Rotate left by one bit
                    q <= {q[98:0], q[99]};
                default: // 2'b00 and 2'b11: Do not rotate
                    q <= q;
            endcase
        end
    end

endmodule
```

module TopModule (
    input  wire        clk,
    input  wire        load,
    input  wire [ 1:0] ena,
    input  wire [99:0] data,
    output reg  [99:0] q
);

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (load) begin
            q <= data;
        end else begin
            case (ena)
                2'b01:   // Rotate right by one bit
                    q <= {q[0], q[99:1]};
                2'b10:   // Rotate left by one bit
                    q <= {q[98:0], q[99]};
                default: // 2'b00 and 2'b11: Do not rotate
                    q <= q;

        end
    end

endmodule
